sloka: एवं रुद्राद्वरं लब्ध्वा भूय एव महासुरः ।प्रणिपत्य महादेवं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। ७.६१.११ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ rudrādvaraṁ labdhvā bhūya eva mahāsuraḥ ।praṇipatya mahādevaṁ vākyametaduvāca ha ।। 7.61.11 ॥

translations.english: Having thus obtained a boon from Rudra, the great Asura bowed down to the great god and spoke these words again.
